context_requirements: Functional HRH3 receptor expression; HRH3 is predominantly neuronal and is not a canonical feature of the nine tested cancer lines
Gq/Ca2+ or Gi/o signaling competence if any HRH3-mediated effect were to occur
Presence of histamine/autocrine ligand tone, which is not established in these lines
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Evidence of HRH3 pathway activation (e.g., Ca2+ flux or cAMP changes) accompanied by downstream gene regulation
